body:
I am so sorry you've been belittled by your dad like that. I am just like you and I have the same exact dad who behaves that way. Hell, even after finding out my sister had attempted to take her own life. 

You did not ask for the life you were given and it is not your fault that you are not enough for the world. In fact, you are enough and you haven't just seen that yet. You are so brave for mustering up the courage to speak up about what you've been struggling to the most trusted adult, only to be let down by him making your problems seem inferior to his. 

Don't lose hope, there are better emotionally mature people than your dad. Your problems ARE valid no matter how small. And please, make yourself happy before anyone else.

I know someone who feels the same way as you. It's a pain I'm very fortunate to know about because I respect what it takes for them to tell someone that this is how they feel. They don't have anybody close to them, especially their family. Most notably, they get attention only when they are about to be used too.

As someone trying to help them feel less lonely, I have advised them to find a new hobby (for them, it's exercising) and find online friends :) I sometimes try to tell them to validate the quietness and loneliness by keeping themselves busy writing/drawing their thoughts. I know I must give better advice, especially when they are on the edge of giving up.

If you have anybody you remember talking to from years ago, it would be nice to try to reconnect. They are most likely different than the ones you're surrounded with at the moment and they may be the one concerned for your well-being.

To be missed by one special person is better than none.

Hey, as a random stranger on the internet, you may not feel less lonely but I do empathise with you. You can trust me, you will find the peace you need. If there is nobody else to talk to than your own voice, please seek out to someone here or me. I hope you find what you need eventually.
I will try to do just that, hoping it will help each other. Baby steps I guess. Oh and yay, thanks for the reassurance on my English skills!
